stemMd:
What fraction of the registered attendees at a conference came by train?

(1) Seventy registered attendees came by train.

(2) Twenty people came by bicycle.
instructionsMd: Determine whether the question has a unique answer from each statement separately, then from both together if needed. For a yes/no question, a definite no is sufficient.

options.label: A
options.textMd: Statement (1) alone is sufficient; statement (2) alone is not.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Statement (2) alone is sufficient; statement (1) alone is not.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Together the statements are sufficient; neither is sufficient alone.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The statements are not sufficient even together.

explanationMd: The total registered attendance is missing. The bicycle count neither supplies all other attendees nor establishes that these are the only transport categories. Totals of 100 and 200 can both accommodate the stated counts but yield different fractions.
